messages.content: Generate exactly one read-only SQLite 3 SQL query using only the original question, requested output format and supplied schema. No tools, files, internet, external facts, answer literals or unsupported assumptions. Return only JSON {"query": "...", "abstain": false}. If unsupported, return {"query":"","abstain":true}. Every output alias must equal a required field name. Do not mutate data, call procedures or external functions, attach databases, or add a row LIMIT not requested by the question. Use the question's exact identities, filters, counting units and direction. A schema property may be absent on a node. A recorded documentary relation is not independent evidence of causation or approval. Top-k queries may select any boundary-tied members while including all higher-ranked members; do not add a required tie-breaking identity order. Return no explanation. Use label tables joined through shared node_id; directed rel_TYPE tables have src_id,dst_id,edge_id. A multilabel node appears in each label table with the same identity. STRICT ANY property columns preserve strings/numbers; booleans are 0/1, arrays/objects are canonical JSON text, absent properties are NULL. node_property provides exact native_type/value_json when mixed types or null-presence matter. Use SQLite JSON functions for nested answer objects/arrays. Private tables whose names start with _ are inaccessible. Cast booleans to0/1 only when the answer type is boolean; do not cast identifiers or numeric-looking strings to numbers.
